verdict.rationale: The docs cover all three distribution paths in the story. Skills can be committed to a project, since Codex scans `.agents/skills` from the working directory up to the repo root and teams can check in folder-specific skills. Repo and local marketplaces are explicitly described as team-distribution sources, added with `codex plugin marketplace add`, and skills can be packaged as installable plugins and published through a reviewed public directory. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of team-wide distribution workflows, and clarity on surface-specific availability limits for repo marketplaces.
